lines.en: label day263:
scene kandasoutside1
: Well, well, well...Would you look who we have here?
lines.zh: : 哎呀哎呀哎呀……瞧瞧这是谁啊？

lines.en: : Am I being mugged?
lines.zh: : 我这是要被打劫了？

lines.en: I run into the Kanda sisters on my way home from[school], who are about to shake me down for all I am worth if we’re basing the rest of this event on Kirin’s first line of dialogue.
lines.zh: 我在[school]放学回家的路上撞见了 Kanda 姐妹，如果按 Kirin 开场白来推断接下来的走向，她们是要把我榨干为止。

lines.en: : Yes. Give us all of your money.
lines.zh: : 没错。把你所有的钱交出来。

lines.en: : We need to buy cigarettes and guns and other stuff that we’re definitely into despite our outwardly adorable appearances.
lines.zh: : 我们要买烟、买枪，还有其他我们绝对喜欢的东西，尽管我们外表看起来可爱极了。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Karin, are you in on this too?
lines.zh: : Karin，你也有份？

lines.en: : ...Karin?
lines.zh: : ……Karin？

lines.en: scene kandasoutside2
: Talking is hard.
lines.zh: : 说话好难。

lines.en: : I’m just going to stand here and let Kirin take your money.
lines.zh: : 我就站在这儿，让 Kirin 把你的钱拿走。

lines.en: : I will buy lunch from the convenience store and eat all by myself, letting the snow pile up over my body and carry me off to a new life.
lines.zh: : 我会去便利店买份午饭，一个人吃掉，然后让雪一层层盖在我身上，把我带去新的人生。

lines.en: : Wait, you don’t actually need money, do you? Because I’m not giving you any.
lines.zh: : 等等，你们其实不是真要钱吧？因为我一分都不会给。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside3
: Uhh...no.
lines.zh: : 呃……不是。

lines.en: : How come everyone else is able to come up to you after[school] but the second I do it, you think you’re being mugged?
lines.zh: : 怎么别人下[school]后来找你都行，我一这么做，你就以为自己被打劫了？

lines.en: : How would I even mug you? Have you seen me? I’m like a third of your size.
lines.zh: : 我拿什么打劫你啊？你看看我？我大概只有你三分之一大。

lines.en: : To be honest, I feel a lot safer knowing it’s just you against me now. Karin was the one I was worried about.
lines.zh: : 说实话，知道现在只剩你一个人对我，我安心多了。我担心的本来是 Karin。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside4
: Why are you worried about her and not me?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么担心她不担心我？！

lines.en: : Why are you worried about me to begin with?! What did I do wrong?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要担心我啊？！我做错什么了？！

lines.en: : Relax, soccer sisters. No one is fighting anyone today.
lines.zh: : 放松点，足球姐妹。今天没人要打架。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside5
: ...What did you just call us?
lines.zh: : ……你刚才叫我们什么？

lines.en: : Soccer sisters...
lines.zh: : 足球姐妹……

lines.en: : I love it.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢。

lines.en: : I personally prefer that the people I’m talking to use my actual name, but it’s whatever, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我个人更希望跟我说话的人用我真名，不过算了，随便吧。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside6
: What are you up to? Going home early?
lines.zh: : 你这是要去干嘛？早退回家？

lines.en: : Early? I’m going home at the same time I always do.
lines.zh: : 早退？我和平时一个点儿回家。

lines.en: : Really? Don’t you normally sit in your fancy office chair after[school] and wait for girls to show up and “talk?”
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你平时不是下[school]后坐在那张高级办公椅上，等女生来找你「谈话」吗？

lines.en: : If the nurse can take Fridays off, so can I.
lines.zh: : 既然保健老师周五能休息，我也能。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot the first year teachers also acted as counselors.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我忘了一年级的老师还兼心理辅导。

lines.en: : Is that not how it works for your grade?
lines.zh: : 你们年级不是这样？

lines.en: : We just have one counselor who handles all of the classes.
lines.zh: : 我们整个年级只有一个辅导老师。

lines.en: : Probably because everyone has already resigned themselves to how much [high_school] sucks by the second year and is tired of complaining about it.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为到了二年级，大家都已经认命[high_school]有多烂，懒得再抱怨了。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside7
: But vulnerable, impressionable girls like myself rely on our teachers to make us feel better about the things that ail us. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 但像我这样脆弱又容易受影响的女生，还是得靠老师来让我们对自己的烦恼好受一点。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yes, but in an incredibly roundabout way.
lines.zh: : 对，只不过方式极其迂回。

lines.en: : You’ve...been seeing a guidance counselor?
lines.zh: : 你……一直在看心理辅导老师？

lines.en: : Kirin, I don’t know if you’re joking, but-
lines.zh: : Kirin，我不知道你是不是在开玩笑，不过——

lines.en: : So, Sensei, have you heard the news?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei，您听说那个消息了吗？

lines.en: scene kandasoutside8
: News? What news?
lines.zh: : 消息？什么消息？

lines.en: : A certain “soccer sister” might be changing classes soon.
lines.zh: : 某位「足球姐妹」可能很快就要换班了。

lines.en: : What? You’re not in Ms. Watabe’s class, are you?
lines.zh: : 什么？你该不会在 Watabe 老师的班上吧？

lines.en: : I was at the beginning of the year but she axed me like, right off the bat.
lines.zh: : 年初在，但她一上来就把我踢出去了。

lines.en: : So they moved me to class C, but I’ve been really obnoxious in there because that teacher sucks even more.
lines.zh: : 所以他们把我转到了 C 班，但我在那儿特别招人烦，因为那个老师更烂。

lines.en: : So, by process of elimination, I’ve got a preeeeetty good chance of ending up with you next.
lines.zh: : 所以，排除法下来，我接下来落到您班上的几率相——当——大。

lines.en: : Unless they just decide to expel me instead. But a mind is a terrible thing to waste and blah blah blah adult-speak.
lines.zh: : 除非他们干脆决定把我开除。不过浪费头脑是件可怕的事，吧啦吧啦，大人腔。

lines.en: : Is there an open seat next to Ayane, by any chance?
lines.zh: : 请问 Ayane 旁边还有空位吗？

lines.en: : Hold on a second. I can’t tell if you’re actually being serious right now.
lines.zh: : 等一下。我分不清你现在到底是认真的还是开玩笑。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside9
: You need me to spell it out for you?
lines.zh: : 需要我明说出来吗？

lines.en: : I, Kirin Kanda, have been intentionally provoking teachers to try and wind up in your class since the first time I heard Miku talk about you.
lines.zh: : 我，Kirin Kanda，自从第一次听 Miku 谈起您之后，就一直在故意惹恼老师，就为了能进您的班。

lines.en: : Couldn’t you have just...asked for a transfer?
lines.zh: : 你就不能……直接申请转班？

lines.en: : A - There is literally zero fun in that.
lines.zh: : A——那样一点都不好玩。

lines.en: : B - If a girl just asks to be transferred into the hot teacher’s class, literally everyone will start to think “you know what” is going on.
lines.zh: : B——如果一个女生主动要求转到帅老师班上，所有人立刻就会开始想「你懂的」那件事。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside10
: Who knows what? I don’t follow.
lines.zh: : 懂什么？我没听懂。

lines.en: : I’m saying that people are going to think I want to fuck him.
lines.zh: : 我是说，大家会觉得我想跟他上床。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside11
: Kirin!
lines.zh: : Kirin！

lines.en: : Just because he’s also our coach doesn’t mean you can say such vulgar things in front of him!
lines.zh: : 就算他也是我们的教练，你也不该在他面前说这么粗俗的话！

lines.en: : Why not? He doesn’t care at all. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？他一点都不在乎。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : It’s true. I really don’t.
lines.zh: : 是真的。我真不在乎。

lines.en: : Of course he doesn’t care. It’s not his reputation at stake if someone hears that.
lines.zh: : 他当然不在乎。被人听见的又不是他的名声。

lines.en: : Okay, I know people around here don’t exactly think too highly of me, but something like that would definitely still have some effect on my reputation.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我知道这地方的人对我的评价本来就不高，但这种事肯定还是会影响到我的名声。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside12
: Oooooh, okay...Okay. You just don’t want somebody to hear me saying anything inappropriate because it will make you look bad. Gotcha.
lines.zh: : 哦——好……好吧。你只是不想让别人听见我说不合适的话，因为那会让你看起来很糟。明白了。

lines.en: : I’m worried about what people will think of you. I don’t care what anyone has to say about me.
lines.zh: : 我担心的是别人会怎么看你。别人怎么说我，我不在乎。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside13
: Easy for you to say when-
lines.zh: : 你说得倒轻巧——

lines.en: scene kandasoutside14
: Ugh...Just forget about it.
lines.zh: : 呃……算了当我没说。

lines.en: : Anyway, Sensei, point is that you shouldn’t be surprised if I suddenly wind up switching classes again.
lines.zh: : 总之，Sensei，重点是，如果我突然又换了班，您别太惊讶。

lines.en: : I’ll do my best to be a model student so I don’t embarrass you the same way I embarrass my older sister.
lines.zh: : 我会努力当个模范学生，免得像让我姐丢脸那样让您丢脸。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside15
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 干嘛？您为什么这么看着我？

lines.en: : Your face is really red all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 你的脸突然好红。

lines.en: : It is not.
lines.zh: : 才没有。

lines.en: : Do you two fight like this often?
lines.zh: : 你们俩经常这么吵吗？

lines.en: : No. This is the first time ever.
lines.zh: : 不。这是第一次。

lines.en: : Is that sarcasm?
lines.zh: : 这是反话吧？

lines.en: : Of course it’s fucking sarcasm. Why are we even talking about this right now?
lines.zh: : 当然是他的反话。我们到底为什么在聊这个啊？

lines.en: : You should be celebrating that I jumped through so many hoops for the chance to study under you.
lines.zh: : 您该庆祝一下才对，为了能当您的学生，我可是跳过了那么多圈。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside16
: Doesn’t it sound fun to have one more girl under you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 您身下再多一个女生，听起来是不是很带劲，Sensei？

lines.en: : I’m leaving now.
lines.zh: : 我走了。

lines.en: : Are you coming home tonight or do I have to tell Mom to wrap your food in advance so you can eat whenever you decide to show up instead?
lines.zh: : 你今晚回来吗，还是要我跟妈说，提前把你的饭包好，等你什么时候想回来再吃？

lines.en: : The latter, please. I had plans with some friends tonight anyway.
lines.zh: : 选后者，谢谢。反正我今晚跟朋友有约。

lines.en: : I’m sure you did.
lines.zh: : 我猜也是。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside17
Karin redirects her gaze from the ground to me and stares into my eyes for significantly longer than she ever has before.
lines.zh: Karin 把视线从地上移开，抬眼看进我的眼睛，比以往任何一次都久得多。

lines.en: Normally, this would be the part where she blushes and runs away.
lines.zh: 按惯例，这时候她该脸红跑掉了。

lines.en: Or collapses.
lines.zh: 或者晕倒。

lines.en: Or anything equally...Karin-ish.
lines.zh: 或者任何同样……很 Karin 的反应。

lines.en: But instead, she just looks at me.
lines.zh: 但这一次，她只是看着我。

lines.en: Speaking nothing.
lines.zh: 什么也不说。

lines.en: Doing nothing.
lines.zh: 什么也不做。

lines.en: Just...
lines.zh: 只是……

lines.en: Staring.
lines.zh: 盯着看。

lines.en: : Please watch over her.
lines.zh: : 请照顾好她。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside18
And then she leaves.
lines.zh: 然后她就走了。

lines.en: : Please watch over me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 请照顾好我，Sensei。

lines.en: : I keep getting into trouble and need someone like you to bail me out.
lines.zh: : 我老是惹麻烦，需要像您这样的人来捞我。

lines.en: : You know she was just looking out for you, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道她只是在关心你吧？

lines.en: : You know she’s just obligated to do that since she’s the older sister, right?
lines.zh: : 您知道她只是因为当姐姐才不得不这么做吧？

lines.en: : It’s her job to make sure I don’t talk about fucking my future teacher in public and it’s my job to sneak into her closet and cut her dresses into pieces.
lines.zh: : 她的工作是确保我不会在大庭广众之下说要操我将来的老师，而我的工作是溜进她的衣柜把她的裙子剪成碎片。

lines.en: : I really hope that’s not a thing you do to her.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你没对她干过这种事。

lines.en: : Not anymore, it’s not. Being grounded for two months was not a good time.
lines.zh: : 现在不干了。被禁足两个月可不好受。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside19
: But that’s beside the point~
lines.zh: : 不过这不是重点~

lines.en: Kirin grabs me by the tie and pulls me away from the entrance of the[school].
lines.zh: Kirin 一把抓住我的领带，把我从[school]门口拽开。

lines.en: People can obviously still see us, just...less people, I guess.
lines.zh: 明显还是有人能看见我们，只是……人少一点吧，我想。

lines.en: : Be more excited about this or I’ll feel dumb for being excited myself.
lines.zh: : 您表现得再兴奋点，不然我会为自己这么兴奋而觉得傻。

lines.en: : Who said I’m not excited?
lines.zh: : 谁说我不兴奋了？

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound very convincing.
lines.zh: : 听着不太有说服力。

lines.en: : Do you want me to jump up and down and shout “Yipee?”
lines.zh: : 你想让我跳起来大喊「好耶」吗？

lines.en: scene kandasoutside20
: No. That would make me feel really uncomfortable now that I’m picturing it.
lines.zh: : 不。我现在一想象那个画面，就觉得浑身不舒服。

lines.en: : Please stop picturing it.
lines.zh: : 请你别再想象了。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside21
: Ew. It’s actually kind of gross.
lines.zh: : 呕。其实还挺恶心的。

lines.en: : Why my class, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，为什么是我的班？

lines.en: scene kandasoutside22
: The fact that you need to ask is actually very upsetting.
lines.zh: : 您居然还要问，这真的让人很受伤。

lines.en: : I mean, I get why you’d want to be in my class...but I figured you'd also think something like “It’s less fun if it happens all the time.”
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我懂你为什么想进我的班……但我以为你也会觉得「天天都这样就不有趣了」。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside23
: You mean like, you think I’ll stop wanting to be around you if I’m around you all the time?
lines.zh: : 您是说，您觉得如果我天天跟您在一起，就不会想跟您在一起了？

lines.en: : Yeah. That.
lines.zh: : 对。就是这个。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside24
: Holy shit. What if you’re right?
lines.zh: : 我操。万一您说对了呢？

lines.en: : I didn’t even think about that.
lines.zh: : 我根本没想过这一点。

lines.en: : For all I know, you could completely lose interest in me the second I’m easier to obtain.
lines.zh: : 说不定我一变得容易到手，你就会彻底对我失去兴趣。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside25
: Stop understanding me all of a sudden!
lines.zh: : 别突然这么懂我啊！

lines.en: : I’ve done it. I’ve uncovered part of Kirin Kanda.
lines.zh: : 我做到了。我揭开了 Kirin Kanda 的一部分。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside26
: You’ve uncovered several parts of me before.
lines.zh: : 您以前也揭开过我好几个部分。

lines.en: : But for some reason, this one is significantly more embarrassing than the others. And I didn’t even cum this time.
lines.zh: : 但不知为什么，这次比以往都让人难为情。而且我这次连高潮都没到。

lines.en: : This conversation would be very strange if you did.
lines.zh: : 要是到了，这对话就非常诡异了。

lines.en: : So now what?
lines.zh: : 那现在怎么办？

lines.en: : What do you mean now what? Is your transfer finalized?
lines.zh: : 什么叫现在怎么办？你的转班定了吗？

lines.en: : Probably. Maybe? I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 大概。也许？我不知道。

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Yes it is.
lines.zh: : 确实定了。

lines.en: : I join your class on Wednesday.
lines.zh: : 我周三进您的班。

lines.en: : Is this the end of our relationship?
lines.zh: : 那我们的关系到此为止了吗？

lines.en: : Obviously not. You have to at least fuck me first.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。您至少得先跟我上床。

lines.en: : After that, we can figure something out.
lines.zh: : 在那之后，我们再想办法。

lines.en: : Doesn’t the fact that you’ll be allowed to skip whenever you want now kind of void the purpose of our deal in the-
lines.zh: : 你现在想翘课就翘课，这不就等于让我们那个交易失去意义了吗——

lines.en: scene kandasoutside27
: You will fuck me and you will like it!
lines.zh: : 您会跟我上床，而且您会乐在其中！

lines.en: : I hope!
lines.zh: : 希望如此！

lines.en: : I don’t know. I could be horrible.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我也许很差劲。

lines.en: : I’m probably not, but there’s always a chance.
lines.zh: : 大概不会，但总有机会。

lines.en: : I’ll do my best!
lines.zh: : 我会尽力的！

lines.en: scene kandasoutside28
: Today’s been a weird day.
lines.zh: : 今天真是奇怪的一天。

lines.en: : I woke up late...then I had to ask for a transfer...and now you’ve got me questioning my own feelings about-
lines.zh: : 我起晚了……然后还得去申请转班……现在您又让我开始怀疑自己对——

lines.en: scene kandasoutside29
: Oh my god. Are you hard?
lines.zh: : 我的天哪。您硬了？

lines.en: : That “You will fuck me and you will like it” line got to me.
lines.zh: : 是那句「您会跟我上床，而且您会乐在其中」戳到我了。

lines.en: : Yeah...I can see that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我看出来了。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside30
: Okay, so, being around you more than normal might be less of an issue than we think.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这么看来，比平时更常跟您待在一起，问题也许没我们想的那么大。

lines.en: : I figured that out when you accidentally mentioned asking for a transfer.
lines.zh: : 你无意中提到自己申请转班的时候，我就明白了。

lines.en: : Did I actually say that?
lines.zh: : 我真说过那话？

lines.en: : Right before noticing my erection.
lines.zh: : 就在你注意到我勃起之前。

lines.en: : Huh.
: It’s still there.
lines.zh: : 还硬着。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside31
: I know it’s still there! But even I’m not crazy enough to jerk you off in the courtyard while everyone is still leaving[school]!
lines.zh: : 我知道还硬着！可就算是我，也没疯到在大家还在离开[school]的时候，在院子里给您打飞机！

lines.en: : You’re going to have to...stop having a hard-on!
lines.zh: : 您必须得……别再勃起了！

lines.en: : Right now.
lines.zh: : 现在就停。

lines.en: : Wow.
: No one’s ever told me that before.
lines.zh: : 从来没人跟我说过这种话。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside32
: Listen, you can do all the perverted stuff you want to me when I move into the dorms.
lines.zh: : 听着，等我搬进宿舍，您想对我做什么变态的事都行。

lines.en: : But for now, I’ve gotta...go for a walk and take some time to think about...stuff that I need to think about.
lines.zh: : 但现在，我得……去散个步，花点时间想想……我该想的事。

lines.en: : It’s not like me to actually go out of my way for something like this.
lines.zh: : 为了这种事特意费心思，一点都不像我。

lines.en: : What is like you exactly? Because I still have no idea.
lines.zh: : 那到底什么才像你？因为我到现在还是一无所知。

lines.en: : I don’t know. That’s a thing I have to think about as well.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这也是我得想想的事。

lines.en: scene kandasoutside33
: So, like...do you really visit everyone in their rooms? You do, right?
lines.zh: : 那个……您真的会去每个人的房间吗？会的吧？

lines.en: : That's not just a rumor?
lines.zh: : 那不只是传闻？

lines.en: : The dorms are like a second home for me. Just all of the doors are locked and I’d probably get in trouble if anyone important ever heard me say that.
lines.zh: : 宿舍对我来说就像第二个家。只不过每扇门都锁着，而且要是被什么重要人物听见我说这话，我大概会有麻烦。

lines.en: : And when I move in, you’ll visit me too?
lines.zh: : 那我搬进去以后，您也会来找我吗？

lines.en: : There is a high likelihood of that happening.
lines.zh: : 这种可能性相当高。

lines.en: : What if my roommate sucks?
lines.zh: : 要是我室友很烂怎么办？

lines.en: : Even better.
lines.zh: : 那更好。

lines.en: : Not that kind of suck.
lines.zh: : 不是那种「烂」。

lines.en: : Oh.
: I don’t know. I’ll figure something out.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我会想办法的。

lines.en: : Doesn’t your current class have dorms, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你现在的班不也有宿舍吗？

lines.en: : Technically, yes. But it’s in a different building and no one I really like is there...so I’ve just been staying with my parents.
lines.zh: : 严格来说有。但在另一栋楼，我喜欢的没一个人在那儿……所以我一直住在父母家。

lines.en: : At least in your building, I’ll have Miku to chill with if you ever get bored of me.
lines.zh: : 至少在您那栋楼，要是您哪天烦我了，我还能找 Miku 玩。

lines.en: : Or if I’m horrible at sex.
lines.zh: : 或者我要是床上很差劲。

lines.en: : You’re probably not.
lines.zh: : 你大概不会。

lines.en: : But there’s always a chance.
lines.zh: : 但总有机会。

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: scene kandasoutside34
: I’m fine! Thank you for asking!
lines.zh: : 我很好！谢谢关心！

lines.en: : I’m...gonna go now!
lines.zh: : 我……先走了！

lines.en: : Right...
: I’ll...see you next week, I guess!
lines.zh: : 那我……下周见吧，大概！

lines.en: : Are you going to apologize to your sister for yelling at her?
lines.zh: : 你打算为冲你姐大吼去道歉吗？

lines.en: : Maybe!
lines.zh: : 也许吧！

lines.en: : I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！

lines.en: : Probably!
lines.zh: : 大概会！

lines.en: scene kandasoutside35
: Ahh! Get out of my head!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！别在我脑子里！

lines.en: scene black
Huh...
So Kirin Kanda is transferring into my class.
lines.zh: 所以 Kirin Kanda 要转进我的班了。

lines.en: Is something like that really okay while students from the other[school] are still trickling in one by one?
lines.zh: 在另一所[school]的学生还在一个个陆续进来的时候，这种事真的没问题吗？

lines.en: Granted, my class is still on the smaller side, but...
lines.zh: 诚然，我的班规模还是偏小，不过……

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: I just never thought Kirin would go to the effort of actually making a change that drastic.
lines.zh: 我只是从没想过 Kirin 会为了这么大的改变真的费那个劲。

lines.en: She’s always just seemed to go with the flow or whatever the hip new term for being a modern drifter is.
lines.zh: 她看起来一直都是随波逐流的那种人，或者用时下流行的说法，一个现代漂泊者。

lines.en: Regardless, I’m sure she’ll...liven up the class in a multitude of ways.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我相信她会以各种方式……让班里热闹起来。

lines.en: If anything, at least I can count on things being slightly more interesting from now on.
lines.zh: 要说有什么好处，至少从今往后的日子肯定会更有意思一点。

lines.zh: Kirin 的好感度提升到了 [kirin_love]！
